selections.statement: For fixed first program a and fixed terminal task, augment the closure measurement z_a(p) with rho_p,j=max over s in S(p) of D_j eta(s), and preserve every prefix-feasible rational bound using a continuation depending on that pair.
assumptions: Actual finite correlated complete paths W
selections.availability_obligation: rho_p must be constant on each fibre of p -> z_a(p) to be computable from the approved input
source_comparison: IY Assumption 1 p4 and Theorems 1-2 pp6-7 require their rectangular fully observed model
WKR Proposition 2.4 p10 already shows usefulness of history for coupled uncertainty
selections.reason: An unobservable rho grants a new sensor; an observable rho adds no information and equal residual reconstruction is not a contribution.
selections.falsification_route_not_executed: Inspect equal-z prefixes for unequal rho; to establish an actual feasibility loss also require prefix feasibility witnesses and a rational common-continuation infeasibility certificate. Unequal rho alone is insufficient.
selections.proof_needed_if_reopened: First establish physically available input and a useful source-supported non-elementary remaining statement; then a checker-backed general proof or exact scoped separating certificate. Not authorized.

selections.statement: Use rho_bar_j(z)=max over p with z_a(p)=z and s in S(p) of D_j eta(s) as an available task-specific information summary.
assumptions: Same frozen model and information as W2-S1
Known finite W, fixed a and exact z
Actual unions of conditional suffix sets, not marginal products
selections.availability_obligation: Satisfied by finite model enumeration from z and known constants; realized p and suffix are not inferred
source_comparison: DVM Definition 1 and Theorem 1 pp4-5 give available-memory compression requirements
WKR Proposition 2.4 p10 prevents presenting history benefit alone as a new mechanism
Inherited wave-1 residual LPs already stack one common continuation within each state cell
selections.reason: This computes the approved state-cell robust problem, not the prefix oracle. Equal residual systems and rowwise maximization supply no useful non-elementary source delta.
selections.falsification_route_not_executed: Reject implementations selecting b by hidden prefix or suffix; check actual cell LPs at each q rather than a single optimum or sampled action menu.
selections.proof_needed_if_reopened: A genuinely changed source-grounded mechanism, with explicit rational attainment and feasibility quantifiers. No further proof work on reconstruction authorized.
